description:
Universal provider proxy for OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.

opencodex is a universal provider proxy for OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, Claude Desktop, and Grok Build: a local proxy that lets them run on many different LLM providers from a single port, translating between API wire formats.

Features:
- Works with Anthropic, Google, xAI, Groq, OpenRouter, Azure, DeepSeek, Ollama, and 40+ other built-in providers.
- Supports streaming, tool calls, reasoning, and images.
- Handles OAuth logins and a ChatGPT account pool.
- Native model picker in the Codex app, sub-agents, and search/vision sidecars.
Published to npm as @bitkyc08/opencodex@2.92.0 with dist-tag latest.
New Features
- Support x-hermes-conversation-id for Hermes session correlation (carry #7459) (#7542)
- Resolve each API key's project with project "auto" (#7296)
- Opt-in session pin keeps a JEV combo session on its decided target (#7567)
- Add subscription and credit support (#7604)
- Avoid rescanning and flattening fragmented SSE carry (carry #7497, #7498) (#7541)
- Read Abliteration credit balance from /v1/credits (#7581)
Bug Fixes
- Persist Reserve helper refusal request IDs (#7511)
- Normalize analytics usage rows (#7510)
- Preserve replay-refusal provenance through response finalization (#7458)
- Honor upstream no-retry verdict (carry #7505) (#7538)
- Preserve unrelated authenticated loopback proxies (#7509)
- Reject macOS ACL-exposed state (#7520)
- Finish with length when a Responses upstream reports incomplete reason "length" (#7539)
- Use attested capabilities for local usage comparisons (#7514)
- Distrust picker freshness without binding evidence (#7522)
- Publish Antigravity family quota as decision evidence (carry #7442) (#7549)
- Read the effective SID in-process so service install does not wait on a cold PowerShell (#7548)
- Bind CLI update plans to installation content and pre-dotenv transport (#7546)
- Route models only to accounts whose roster serves them (#7556)
- Refresh dated Token Plan catalogue and metadata (#7555)
- Keep retrying failed Home tunnels, report Child link readiness, record tunnel diagnostics (#7560)
- Infer message phase for passthrough providers (#7554)
- Backfill Token Plan output limits on roster refresh (#7576)
- Fold developer role to system for moonshot (#7584)
- Isolate retained reasoning state by admitted caller (carry #7523) (#7566)
- Stop guardian refresh of grants persisted as revoked (#7597)
- Keep the stored strategy when combo set replaces targets (#7601)
- Send native ultra effort as max on the wire (#7590) (#7600)
- Keep npm Node cache within inspection lifetime (#7585)
- Revoke usage trials after identity verification fails (#7582)
- Refuse uncertain prefix-local Node observations (#7577)
- Check the first hard-lock combo destination (#7588)
- Always send a title on url_citation and repair old history on replay (#7573)
- Ship Bun 1.4.4 runtime to drop the compromised eMudhra root (#7606)
- Pin zod/body-parser for 2.92.0 audit:high republish (#7643)
- Bump gui happy-dom to 21.0.4 for 2.92.0 (GHSA-834v-8h66-3h79) (#7645)
Documentation
- Record the 2.92.0 sweep wave plan (#7535)
- Explain how spawn_agent fills its five model slots (#7550)
- Show the SignPath attribution and code signing policy on the download section (#7571)
- End release notes with the SignPath code signing attribution (#7570)
- An existing JEV combo keeps its stored decision method (#7602)
Chores
- Deprecate mimo-free (#7445)
- Move the Abliteration quota test to a shard to restore the layout.json size cap on dev (#7607)
Other Changes
- Open dev at 2.92.0 before releasing 2.91.0 (#7532)
- Promote frozen tip 03bcf789e9 to main as 2.92.0 (#7634)
